# Machine records

**Role:** reference
**Status:** generated by `femkit schema docs` — do not edit
**Authority:** none of its own; the schema models are the authority for `<config>/machines/<name>.toml` (jobs.md § 9)

## Record

One machine's record, as measured on it (jobs.md § 9.1).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | `1` | required | the record's schema version: one of `1` |
| `measured` | [Measured](#measured) | required | when and where the probe ran |
| `identity` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the scheduler's cluster name, or the host name |
| `host` | [Host](#host) | required | the machine the probe ran on; on a cluster, never what a job is fit against |
| `manager` | [ManagerFacts](#managerfacts) | required | the package manager here |
| `scheduler` | [SchedulerFacts](#schedulerfacts) | required | the scheduler kind, and where its commands are |
| `partitions` | table of text → [Partition](#partition) or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | each partition's limits and node groups |
| `queues` | list of [Queue](#queue) or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | each (partition, QOS) pair this account may submit to |
| `environments` | table of text → [EnvSnapshot](#envsnapshot) or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | `env list` here when the probe ran |
| `settings` | [Settings](#settings) | required | this machine's config.toml values a job run here needs, copied |
| `sources` | table of text → text | empty | dotted part -&gt; what measured it |
| `notes` | list of text | empty | what the probe could not do, and why |

## Measured

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | text | required | when the probe ran, UTC |
| `where` | `workstation` \| `login node` \| `scheduler job` | required | where it ran: one of `workstation`, `login node`, `scheduler job` |

## Unknown

A fact that could not be measured, and why. Never read as zero or none.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unknown` | text | required | why it could not be measured |

## Host

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `os` | text | required | operating system and release |
| `architecture` | text | required | e.g. x86_64 |
| `cores` | integer or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the machine's logical CPUs |
| `memory_mib` | integer or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | its memory |
| `gpus` | list of [HostGPU](#hostgpu) or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | its GPUs, as the driver reports them |

## HostGPU

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | text | required | as the driver reports it; shown, never compared |
| `compute_capability` | text | required | e.g. 8.0 |
| `memory_mib` | integer | required | its memory |

## ManagerFacts

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the manager kind (femkit/data/managers/) |
| `path` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the manager executable |
| `version` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | its version |
| `root` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | its root (base) prefix |
| `platform` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | what an environment built here is for, e.g. linux-64 |
| `run_enters` | boolean or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | whether `&lt;manager&gt; run -p &lt;control prefix&gt;` runs inside that prefix here |

## SchedulerFacts

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | text | required | the scheduler kind (femkit/data/schedulers/) |
| `commands` | table of text → text or [Unknown](#unknown) | empty | each job command by role: where it is |
| `probe` | table of text → text or [Unknown](#unknown) | empty | each probe command by role: where it is |

## Partition

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_time` | `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) or text | required | MaxTime |
| `max_cpus_per_node` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | MaxCPUsPerNode |
| `def_mem_per_cpu_mib` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown), optional | — | DefMemPerCPU, when the partition states it |
| `def_mem_per_node_mib` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown), optional | — | DefMemPerNode, when the partition states it |
| `allow_qos` | `all` or list of text | required | AllowQos |
| `deny_qos` | list of text | empty | DenyQos |
| `node_groups` | list of [NodeGroup](#nodegroup) | empty | its nodes, grouped |

## NodeGroup

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | required | how many nodes are alike in the four facts below |
| `cores` | integer or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | cores per node |
| `memory_mib` | integer or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | memory per node |
| `gpus` | table of text → integer | empty | GPUs per node, {type: count}; {} is none |
| `architecture` | text or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | e.g. x86_64, aarch64 |

## Queue

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partition` | text | required | the partition |
| `qos` | text, optional | — | the QOS; absent when the account's QOS list could not be read |
| `max_time` | `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) or text | required | the shorter of the partition's MaxTime and the QOS's MaxWall |
| `max_cpus` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the QOS's per-job cpu cap (MaxTRESPerJob) |
| `max_memory_mib` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the QOS's per-job memory cap |
| `max_gpus` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | the QOS's per-job GPU cap |
| `max_submit_jobs_per_user` | integer or `unlimited` or [Unknown](#unknown) | required | MaxSubmitJobsPerUser; shown, never counted |

## EnvSnapshot

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | text | required | its state when the probe ran (see envs.md § 3.2) |
| `gpu` | text, optional | — | its GPU qualification, when ready or failing |
| `install_fingerprint` | text, optional | — | from its manifest |
| `solver_version` | text, optional | — | from its manifest |

## Settings

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environments` | text | required | paths.environments, as in effect |
| `mpi` | list of text, optional | — | launch.mpi; absent when unset |
| `preamble` | list of text, optional | — | activation.preamble; absent when unset |
| `activation` | text, optional | — | activation.command; absent when unset |
